title: Trump's former defense secretary sees no end in sight for Iran war — to the benefit of America's 'greatest adversary'
summary_full: Mark Esper, who served as U.S. Secretary of Defense during Trump's first presidential term, said he did not see the conflict ending in the foreseeable future.
